title: Sentinel: Compact Telemetry Overview for Model Routes
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Design a compact, scan-friendly overview ("Sentinel") that surfaces per-model and per-route performance signals (latency p50/p95, tokens/sec throughput, token counts, error rate) for quick ops triage and cost trade-offs. Focus on dense information layout for small teams and consoles where screen real estate is limited (sidebar/panel use). Deliverables: Figma prototype, responsive breakpoints (desktop/medium/compact), component-level chart specs (data contract, axes/aggregation, downsampling rules, color tokens), annotations UI for rollouts/canaries, and acceptance criteria for handoff to telemetry/backend teams.

Scope: This ticket covers the UX and chart contract for the Sentinel panel only (not the full route inspector). It includes mock data, performance-focused chart choices (sparkline + small-multiples), and a compact cost overlay that maps token volume to estimated per-minute cost. Out of scope: full rollout orchestration controls, RBAC, or long-term raw-timeseries export (these will be separate tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype with three responsive states (desktop, medium, compact) linked and comment-resolved
Chart contract doc listing required metrics, aggregation windows (1s/10s/60s), max data points, and fallback behaviours for missing KV cache telemetry
Component spec for compact sparkline + delta micro-badge (p50/p95/throughput) with accessible color tokens and aria labels
A short implementation checklist for telemetry engineers describing required API endpoints and sample JSON payloads
Design review sign-off from PM (Marcus Chen) and Eng lead (Riley Owens)
design_assets: Figma: prototype link with interactions (hover tooltips, panel collapse)
comments: 2026-03-01 Aisha Kapoor: Initial PRD + problem statement posted. Proposed compact layout: left column sparklines per-route, center small-multiples for model-level p50/p95, right-side cost ribbon. Called out need for aggressive downsampling when >1m points.
2026-03-03 Marcus Chen (PM): Added success metric — reduce median triage time by 30% for incidents originating from route QoS signals. Confirmed priority: surface p95 and burst throughput first.

2026-03-05 Luca Martinez (Design): Early prototype created; opted for micro-badges to show instant deltas (▲/▼) next to sparklines. Note: keeping tooltips minimal to reduce cognitive load on compact views.

2026-03-07 Riley Owens (Eng): Backend dependency ENG-48922 flagged — needs a new telemetry aggregation endpoint that returns pre-aggregated 10s buckets for routes. Also noted token-cost estimation requires mapping used GPU pricing from pricing service (dependency ENG-49211).

2026-03-09 Design critique: discussed chart choices. Decision: use stacked area for throughput when comparing multi-model routes, but use line+band (p50 line, p95 shaded band) for latency to preserve trend clarity. Trade-off: area stacks hide p95 spikes; added micro-table to surface recent p95 spike timestamps.

2026-03-10 Accessibility review: ensure color tokens pass 4.5:1 for small badges. Added high-contrast mode and text-only delta state. Action: update Figma color tokens and annotate components with aria label examples.

2026-03-11 Prototype testing: Built clickable Figma flow. Quick hallway testing with three engineers: 2/3 immediately found route with p95 spike; feedback to increase hit target for hover on micro-badges. Updated prototype to enlarge hit area and add keyboard focus state.
2026-03-12 Luca Martinez: Prepared chart contract doc and pushed to Drive; requested eng review for data payloads. Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-design-proposals/pull/128
2026-03-12 Marcus Chen: Marked ticket for In Review; requested eng ETA on telemetry endpoints before final sign-off.
implementation_notes: Chart contract: prefer server-side 10s aggregation for p50/p95 and 60s rollups for historical sparkline thumbnails
Downsampling rule: when >1200 points, apply LTTB downsampling to 300 points for frontend rendering
Tooltip behavior: show exact numeric with timestamp; for p95 show sample count; for tokens show estimated cost USD/min computed client-side when price map provided
Fallbacks: if p95 is null, use p90 and mark with 'P95 unavailable' micro-badge
Interactions: clicking a route row expands to detailed route inspector (separate ticket)
release_notes: Adds Sentinel compact telemetry panel design + chart contracts for console-2026.03; enables eng to build compact overview used in side panels and incident triage flows.
